description:
About the Scholarship

The Portugal Government Scholarships 2027 are prestigious, fully funded opportunities offered by the Portuguese government to international students from around the world. These scholarships aim to attract talented students to pursue Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degrees at Portuguese universities, promoting cultural exchange and academic excellence.

Funding Details & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Full coverage for all program costs.
  • Monthly Stipend: Up to €1,250 per month for living expenses.
  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical coverage.
  • Travel Allowance: Round-trip economy class airfare.
  • Accommodation: Support with finding university housing.
  • Research Costs: Funding for thesis and research projects (for research degrees).
  • Visa Support: Assistance with student visa applications.
  • Language Courses: Portuguese language classes (optional).
  • Cultural Activities: Participation in cultural exchange programs.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Nationality: Be a citizen of any country outside the European Union (EU).
  • Academic Background:
  • Bachelor's applicants: Hold a secondary school diploma or equivalent.
  • Master's applicants: Hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • PhD applicants: Hold a Master's degree or equivalent.
  • Academic Excellence: Demonstrate strong academic performance (typically minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 or equivalent).
  • Language Proficiency: Provide proof of proficiency in English or Portuguese (depending on the program's language of instruction).
  • Admission: Secure unconditional admission or be currently enrolled in a Portuguese university.
  • Age Limit: Generally no age limit, but some programs may have specific requirements.

Eligible Fields of Study

Most fields of study offered at Portuguese universities, including Engineering and Technology, Natural Sciences, Health Sciences, Social Sciences and Humanities, Economics and Management, Arts and Architecture, Law.

Application Process

  1. Research programs and universities.
  2. Check eligibility and requirements.
  3. Prepare application documents: application form, CV, letter of motivation, academic transcripts, proof of degree, language proficiency proof, letters of recommendation, passport copy, photograph, research proposal (for PhD).
  4. Submit university application.
  5. Apply for scholarship via the Study Portugal portal.
  6. Wait for selection results.
  7. Accept scholarship and prepare for Portugal.

Timeline & Deadlines

MilestoneDate
Application opens25 June 2026
Application deadline30 September 2026
University ReviewOctober-November 2026
Government EvaluationNovember-December 2026
NotificationDecember 2026-January 2027
Program StartSeptember 2027

Official Application Portal

https://www.studyportugal.pt/en/scholarships-and-grants

Important Notes

  • Approximately 1000 scholarships awarded annually.
  • Applications for 2027 intake close on 30 September 2026.
  • Scholarship covers most expenses but personal expenses may need to be budgeted.

Official Link

https://www.studyportugal.pt/

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 September 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
